_doc: Addresses that have hard-bounced. The domain-level deliverability check in check_email_domains.py cannot see these: the domain resolves, the MX records answer, and only the MAILBOX is absent. Nothing short of sending finds that out, so once found it must be written down. Keyed by lowercase address. queue_batch.py refuses to send to anything listed here.

addresses.consumerinquiries@rpmleader.com: 550, 2026-08-19. This is the address their own privacy policy designates for consumer privacy requests.
addresses.data@emerges.com: 550 5.1.1 account does not exist, 2026-08-27. The address on eMerges.com's 2024 California registration. Domain has healthy Google Workspace MX; the mailbox is absent.
addresses.dataprivacy@listmatch.com: 550 address not found, 2026-08-27. The address on Email Marketing Services' California registration. Their own privacy page publishes dataprivacy2026@listmatch.com instead - a YEAR-SUFFIXED address that rotates while the registry keeps the old one.
addresses.dataprivacy_rocadvertising@simpleoptoutc: 550 5.1.1, 2026-08-20. A third-party compliance vendor's address, published as ROC Advertising's designated privacy contact. Working first-party address is privacy@rocadvertising.com.
addresses.no-reply@resonate.com: 550 address not found, 2026-08-19. They send from it; it does not receive.
addresses.privacy@4-eyes.ai: no MX record; RFC 5321 A-record fallback host refuses SMTP connections entirely. Gmail retried 48h then failed permanently, 2026-08-25.
addresses.privacy@crawlbee.com: crawlbee.com publishes a null MX (RFC 7505) - an explicit refusal of all mail, 2026-08-25.
addresses.privacy@databaseusa.com: 550 5.1.1 user unknown in relay recipient table, 2026-08-26. In their California registry filing.
addresses.privacy@researchusallc.com: 550 user unknown, 2026-08-26. In their California registry filing. Domain and MX healthy.
addresses.webmaster@searchsystems.net: 550 5.1.1, 2026-08-20. The address published on their own site.
addresses.privacy@rampedup.io: Rejected as a restricted Google Workspace group ('group may not exist or no permission to post'), 2026-08-26. Alternate published on their own site: contact@rampedup.io.
addresses.privacy@venpath.net: Rejected as a restricted Google Workspace group, 2026-08-20. No alternate email published; registry uses the web form at /legal/opt-out as primary.
addresses.security@audiencepoint.com: Rejected as a restricted Google Workspace group, 2026-08-24. Not the registry's primary contact — privacy@audiencepoint.com (the correct, verified address) delivers fine.
addresses.privacy@modigie.com: Rejected as a restricted Google Workspace group, 2026-08-19. Already superseded — registry's email_to was corrected to dpauli@modigie.com on 2026-08-22.
addresses.info@openpeoplesearch.com: 550 address not found, 2026-08-26. This is the exact address published on the broker's own privacy policy — domain and MX are healthy, only the mailbox is absent. Registry uses the web form at /Consumer as primary.
addresses.privacy@onemata.com: 550 address not found, 2026-08-19. All three onemata.com addresses on file are dead; registry points to the web form / phone line (833) 663-6282 as primary.
addresses.privacy@matchandappend.com: 550 address not found, 2026-08-19. Both addresses on file are dead; registry uses the web form as primary.
addresses.ccpa@paramountdirectmarketing.com: 'Recipient Unknown' from Office 365 (postmaster@PARAMOUNTLISTS.COM), 2026-08-18. Registry now uses the reCAPTCHA-gated web form as primary.
addresses.dataprivacy@sourceitmarketing.com: No such recipient, 2026-08-27. This entry (sourceit_technologies) is a duplicate CA registration of 'sourceit', which has a working address (dataprivacy2026@sourceitmarketing.com) already on file — do not resend here.
addresses.privacy@leadershipconnect.io: 550 address not found, 2026-08-19. Site publishes no email at all; registry uses the web form as primary.
addresses.support@structure.ac: Recipient server rejected the message outright, 2026-08-20. Ambiguous whether the mailbox is dead or filtering automated senders; registry already uses the web form as primary.
addresses.privacy@keyopinionleaders.com: Domain has no NS/SOA/A/MX records at all — the registration has lapsed. Reads as a soft delay for 48h before hard-bouncing, 2026-08-20.
addresses.privacy@infofree.com: 550 address not found. Already superseded — registry's email_to was corrected to info@infofree.com on 2026-08-22.
addresses.ccpa@leadmemedia.com: 550 address not found. Already superseded — registry's email_to was corrected to californiaregistry@leadmemedia.com.
addresses.contact@join5x5.com: Domain has no MX and no A record at all — publishes no working mail route. Registry note flags this as almost certainly a typo in the CA filing; the entry is held out of the send queue as a duplicate of five_by_five.
addresses.info@hellofyllo.com: 550 address not found, 2026-08-27. Domain still has live Mimecast MX -- only the mailbox is gone. No published role address on the site.
addresses.privacy@infocore.com: 550 address not found, 2026-08-28. NOT a registry route -- it was mistyped in a send when the registry said info@infocore.com. Recorded anyway because the bounce proves the mailbox is absent, so nothing should try it later. dpo@infocore.com is published on their privacy policy and was adopted instead.
addresses.slyster@idg.com: 550 address not found, 2026-08-27. Registry contact from a state filing, person-shaped. idg.com still has live Outlook and Mimecast MX, so the domain accepts mail and only the mailbox is gone -- the named individual has left. IDG now trades as Foundry (foundryco.com); no role address is published on either domain.
addresses.privacy@imprintanalytics.io: 550 5.1.1 no such user, 2026-08-28. The address Imprint Analytics LLC filed on the California data broker registry -- and the only contact it publishes anywhere. Domain has live Google Workspace MX but serves no website (TLS handshake fails; plain HTTP returns Cloudflare error 1001), so there is no privacy policy page to read a second address off.
